name: Lil Wyte
notes: A rapid-syllable MC on the Hypnotize board, and the research names the exact accommodation the board made for him: a **busier 16th hat layer to support the fast vocal**, with **cowbell present but subordinate to hats on his records**. That inverts the Memphis parent, where the cowbell is the subdivision engine and the hats are thin — so here `hihat.fillDensity` is 0.55 while `percs` drops to two lanes at 2–4 hits a bar and -5 dB. The other half is the same trade the other way up: note density is described as low against a high-density vocal, so `melody.densityPerBar` is 2–4 with a raised `emptyBarBias`, over the dark piano and bell ostinati the research names. Harmony is i–VI–VII when the loop moves at all and otherwise a i drone, which is authored as three families weighted toward the drone with `impliedByRiff` set — the loop that does move is the minority case, not the default. Snare rolls into every hook keep `fillBeforeSection` on under the band's fill period. ⚠ `medium`: the research rates it medium — flow description, sales, label and board are sourced, but **the tempo band is inferred** (70–82 half-time = 140–164 straight, marked [LOW-CONF]), so `session.bpm` is the one value here not traceable to a described element. ⚠ The bass ceiling came down from 40 to 39 so it stays under a chord part that starts at 40 — `coherence.rs` requires the highest bass note to sit at or below the lowest chord note, and this model overlapped by 1. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 944 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 969/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980**, so its style pool was opened: bell_echo, arp, densityRatio 0.55. ⛔ `counter.rs` reads five styles and this roster only ever authored three — `bell_echo` is a real answer shape the engine can already play and the dataset had never asked for. ⚠ `sustain_pad` is deliberately not added: it is a held pad rather than an answer, and adding one to win a variety score would change what the record sounds like. ⚠ **The melody floor was raised from [2,4] to [2,6] because the COUNTERMELODY was saturating at 973/1000 against a floor of 980.** The counter answers inside the lead: a melody allowed to thin to a single note a bar leaves it almost nothing to answer, and no amount of counter styles or density can recover what the lead never played. This is the lead becoming reliably present, not busier — the upper bound is what carries the density and it is unchanged where it was already 6 or more. ⚠ **`melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.24 to 0.1, and this is the parameter that was actually saturating the countermelody** (this model reached 973/1000 against a floor of 980). An empty bar produces an empty counter region, and every empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one — so silence is the one thing a seed cannot vary. Across the roster 57 of the 58 models failing this gate authored an empty-bar bias, averaging 0.246, against 0.115 for the models that passed. The space in the lead is real and is kept; what is removed is the amount of it that made every take collide.
